p: loving favour rather than silver and: Which comes by well doing.
meet together: Live together, and have need the one of the other.
foreseeth the evil: That is, the punishment, which is prepared for the wicked and flees to God for help.
in the way he should go: Bring him up virtuously and he will continue so.
rod of his anger shall fail: His authority by which he oppressed others, will be taken from him.
eye shall be blessed: He that is merciful and liberal.
king shall be his friend: He shows that princes should use their familiarity, whose conscience is good, and their talk wise and godly.
knowledge: Favour them that love knowledge.
There is a lion outside: He derides them that invent vain excuses, because they would not do their duty.
shall fall in it: So God punishes one sin by another, when he suffers the wicked to fall into the acquaintance of a harlot.
in the heart of a child: He is naturally given to it.
the LORD: He shows what the end of wisdom is: that is, to direct us to the Lord.
excellent things in counsels and knowledge: That is, various times.
no friendship with an angry man: Have nothing to do with him that is not able to rule his affections: for he would hurt you by his evil conversation.
strike hands: Who rashly put themselves in danger for others, as in Pr 6:2.
